achievements.label: Power Up
achievements.description: Invest in Output for the first time.

achievements.label: Taking Action
achievements.description: Invest in Permafrost Preservation or Monitoring & Response for the first time.

achievements.label: All Three Fronts
achievements.description: Invest in Output, Preservation, and Monitoring at least once each.

achievements.label: Quarter Shield
achievements.description: Reach 25% feedback dampening in your region.

achievements.label: Half Shield
achievements.description: Reach 50% feedback dampening in your region.

achievements.label: Full Shield
achievements.description: Reach the maximum 85% feedback dampening in your region.

achievements.label: The Tipping Point
achievements.description: Watch your region's permafrost begin melting for the first time.

achievements.label: Ahead of the Melt
achievements.description: Reach at least 25% feedback dampening before your region's permafrost starts melting.

achievements.label: Five Degrees Cooler
achievements.description: Keep your region 5° cooler than the unmitigated counterfactual trajectory.

achievements.label: Ten Degrees Cooler
achievements.description: Keep your region 10° cooler than the unmitigated counterfactual trajectory.

achievements.label: Twenty Degrees Cooler
achievements.description: Keep your region 20° cooler than the unmitigated counterfactual trajectory.

achievements.label: Slowing the Runaway
achievements.description: Fifteen rounds after melt began, keep warming's acceleration under 1.5x the background rate.

achievements.label: Deep Reserves
achievements.description: Reach 500 Funds in your region at once.

achievements.label: Best in Class
achievements.description: By round 15 or later, have a lower temperature than both Region B and Region C.

achievements.label: Side by Side
achievements.description: Invest at least once in both Region B and Region C.

achievements.label: Preset Strategist
achievements.description: Use a preset strategy on Region B or Region C for the first time.

achievements.label: Know Thy Enemy
achievements.description: Reveal the optional worst-case region to see what pure neglect looks like.
